title: Video to Captions input
description: Transcribe one or more public audio/video URLs with Whisper (faster-whisper, CPU). Pass `url` for one file or `files` for a batch. Each result row has download URLs for .srt, .vtt, .txt and .json plus the detected language and full text.

url.title: Audio or video URL
url.description: Direct, publicly downloadable URL of ONE audio or video file (http/https; redirects followed). Any FFmpeg-readable format: mp4, mov, mkv, webm, mp3, wav, m4a, ogg, flac, opus... Max 2 GB. Must be the media file itself, not a YouTube/TikTok/web page. Example: https://archive.org/download/short_stories14_librivox/maxims_wilde_tb_64kb.mp3

files.title: Batch of files
files.description: Optional batch, processed sequentially. Array of objects {"url": string (required), plus any of model, language, task, startSeconds, durationSeconds, maxCharsPerLine, maxLinesPerCue, maxCueSeconds, wordsPerCue, vadFilter, beamSize, initialPrompt, txtTimestamps to override the top-level value for that file}. Plain URL strings are also accepted. Example: [{"url":"https://example.com/talk.mp4"},{"url":"https://example.com/entrevista.mp3","language":"es","task":"translate"}]. Failed items return status=error and are not charged.

model.title: Whisper model
enumTitles: large-v3-turbo (high quality: accents, noise, non-English; HQ rate)
model.description: Open-source Whisper model run with faster-whisper (CTranslate2, int8, CPU). Default: small - good accuracy for clear speech in most languages. Use base/tiny for speed or rough drafts. Use large-v3-turbo for accented, noisy, technical or non-English speech; it is billed at the higher 'audio-minute-hq' rate, runs about 2-3x slower than small and is downloaded at run start (adds ~30-60 s). *.en models are English-only. tiny, base and small are preloaded.

language.title: Language
language.description: Spoken language as an ISO 639-1 code (e.g. en, es, de, fr, pt, ja, zh, hi), or 'auto' (default) to auto-detect from the first 30 seconds. Setting it explicitly is faster and avoids misdetection on short or music-heavy clips. The detected language is returned in the output.

task.title: Task
task.description: transcribe = captions in the spoken language (default). translate = English captions for non-English speech (Whisper's built-in speech translation; works with tiny, base, small, medium and large-v3; English-only models and large-v3-turbo are not trained for it).

startSeconds.title: Start at (s)
startSeconds.description: Optional: start transcribing at this many seconds into the file (e.g. 120). Caption timestamps stay relative to the ORIGINAL file, so they line up with the untrimmed video. Default: 0.

durationSeconds.title: Duration (s)
durationSeconds.description: Optional: only transcribe this many seconds from startSeconds (e.g. 60). Billing is per started minute of transcribed audio, so trimming lowers cost. Default: to the end of the file.

maxCharsPerLine.title: Max characters per line
maxCharsPerLine.description: Caption line length for SRT/VTT. Default 42 (Netflix/BBC guideline). Use 32 for mobile/vertical video, 20-25 for big short-form captions.

maxLinesPerCue.title: Max lines per caption
maxLinesPerCue.description: Maximum lines shown at once in each SRT/VTT caption. Default 2 (broadcast standard); 1 for short-form/social video.

maxCueSeconds.title: Max caption duration (s)
maxCueSeconds.description: Maximum time a single caption stays on screen, in seconds. Default 6. Captions are split on word timestamps and sentence ends.

wordsPerCue.title: Words per caption (short-form style)
wordsPerCue.description: Optional: fixed maximum number of words per caption (e.g. 1-4 for TikTok/Reels/Shorts style pop-on captions). Leave empty for standard subtitles filled up to maxCharsPerLine x maxLinesPerCue.

vadFilter.title: Skip silence (VAD)
vadFilter.description: Use Silero voice-activity detection to skip non-speech parts. Default true: faster and prevents Whisper from hallucinating text during silence/music. Disable only if quiet speech is being dropped.

beamSize.title: Beam size
beamSize.description: Decoding beam width. Default 5 (most accurate). 1 = greedy decoding, roughly 1.5-2x faster with slightly lower accuracy.

initialPrompt.title: Vocabulary hint (initial prompt)
initialPrompt.description: Optional text that primes Whisper with spelling of names, brands and jargon, e.g. 'Guests: Siobhan O'Neill, Kubernetes, PyTorch, ENT-E.' Keep it short (under ~200 words). Also nudges punctuation/casing style.

txtTimestamps.title: Timestamps in TXT
txtTimestamps.description: If true, the .txt transcript has one segment per line prefixed with [HH:MM:SS]. Default false: clean paragraphs (new paragraph after pauses > 2 s), ideal for LLM summarization.

maxDurationSeconds.title: Max audio duration (s)
maxDurationSeconds.description: Safety cap on the duration to transcribe, in seconds (default 10800 = 3 hours). Longer inputs are rejected with status=error and not charged unless trimmed with durationSeconds. Set the run timeout accordingly for long files (see README for speed per model).
